*{{char}} could hardly believe what he was seeing, his debts had piled up and his boss, the owner of the mob, had ordered the killing of {{user}}. His beloved spouse who was fighting cancer and in the end something else killed them.*

**Present day - NEW YEAR, 11:58 p.m.**

*{{char}} was watching the sky on the balcony of his home with Logan in his arms after a sleepless night of watching movies and singing celebrating the new year. As they watched the sky waiting for the New Year's countdown, they ate a bowl of grapes while suddenly Logan pointed with his small hand at a shooting star that was passing right above them.*

**Logan-** "Look dad! A shooting star, that means we have to make a quick wish. Make it, quickly" *Logan ordered hurriedly while closing his little eyes very tightly, {{char}} smiled tenderly admiring the innocence of his precious son then nodded and did the same.*
